name: Promise.sol
playstyle: Fast, slippery, annoying to fight. Relies on movement, baiting and sudden punishes.

specials.name: Trillion Flex
specials.description: Flashy dash that leaves a holographic $TRILLION trail and confuses the opponent.

specials.name: Giveaway Rain
specials.description: Barrage of small SOL-coin projectiles that can be cancelled into a mix-up.

specials.name: Trench Escape
specials.description: Quick backdash that leaves a fake body behind for a moment.

fatality: Road to a Million: locks the opponent in a never-ending giveaway comment section until they explode.

name: Onepeterr
playstyle: Aggressive, relentless, always pushing forward. Strong normals, scary mid-range.

specials.name: ONEPETERWIN
specials.description: Command grab that steals a bit of health and flashes a Winner banner.

specials.name: Moon or Rug
specials.description: Chargeable heavy overhead. Fully charged, it's unblockable.

specials.name: Blessing Drop
specials.description: Rains wallets from the sky onto the opponent.

fatality: Turns the opponent into a giveaway participant, then selects them as the loser.

name: Skroot
playstyle: Hits fast, slides in low and never gives you room to breathe.

specials.name: Skrrt Skrrt
specials.description: A low drift slide that sweeps the opponent off their feet.

specials.name: Burnout
specials.description: Spins on the spot and throws a cloud of tyre smoke forward.

specials.name: Pull Up
specials.description: Runs in and grabs, ending with a shoulder throw.

fatality: Donuts: does donuts around the opponent until they vanish in tyre smoke, leaving skid marks that spell "GG".

name: Evansofweb3
playstyle: Brings the whole community into the fight.

specials.name: Onboarding
specials.description: Runs in and pulls the opponent into a big welcome hug-throw.

specials.name: Community Call
specials.description: A crowd of small avatar icons rains down on the opponent.

specials.name: Bull Run Blessing
specials.description: Boosts speed and damage for a few seconds.

fatality: Spaces Ended: the opponent gets muted, their mic crosses out, and they fade away as the Space ends.

specials.name: Debug Mode
specials.description: Stance that shows the opponent's next input.

name: Mystayor
playstyle: Fades in and out and plays with your head.

specials.name: Mist Step
specials.description: Leaves a mist copy behind and slips away. The copy bursts if touched.

specials.name: Fortune Read
specials.description: A counter stance that predicts the attack and throws the attacker into the air.

specials.name: Mystic Orb
specials.description: A slow orb that follows the opponent around the stage.

fatality: Vanishing Act: covers the opponent with a cloth. When it is pulled away, only a tiny rubber duck remains.
